title: AI sovereignty hinges on domestic compute, governance capacity: UN panel
description: Underscoring that the AI divide is “not just about access, but about capacity to influence AI development”, the panel said countries increasingly need compute infrastructure — public or private — located within their borders to maintain autonomy, leverage, and national security.

title: Hawaii’s Schatz Aims To Tag Every Deepfake In AI Crackdown
description: Sen. Brian Schatz's AI Labeling Act would mandate visible and machine‐readable labels on AI‐generated images, audio, video and chatbots, enforced by the FTC.

title: Cisco outlines people-first AI strategy for workforce shift
description: Cisco says AI adoption needs cultural change, skills investment and human oversight as companies reshape work, learning and internal tools.
